messages:
sam: quick heads-up — changelog cutoff is tomorrow at 5pm PT. we need owners for entries and someone to run the lint sweep. who can pick this up? :wave:

alex: i can own the rota for this batch. will do the first pass around 9am PT tomorrow. please ping me with PR links.

priya: i can run the changelog-lint GH action and triage failures. tag me in the PR and i'll follow up.

ben: FYI branch policy change — release/* branches now require changelog entries in the PR body. tiny heads-up to reviewers. posted the RFC in #eng-policy.

mia: small ask — can we use the compact entry template? it helps with the release notes generator. link: https://redwood.example/docs/release-notes-template.md

sam: perfect — alex (owner), priya (lint), mia (template check). reminder checklist for owners:
```
- verify PR has a changelog entry (short description + component tag)
- run `./scripts/changelog-lint` or rely on GH action
- assign changelog reviewer if ambiguous
- add owner-internal note if breaking change
```

alex: i'll drop a comment like: "@alex — changelog entry present?" on each PR so it's clear. also i'll merge trivial fixes after lint passes.

priya: ran the linter locally on a sample branch and it flagged component tags missing for a couple entries. i'll post a quick how-to in the thread so folks can fix without waiting.

ci-bot: changelog-lint check ran on PR #4821 — status: failure. details: missing component tag in entry. https://github.com/redwood-inference/p/r/4821/checks

mia: posted the mini-guide: use `component: infra|api|runtime|docs` on the first line, e.g., `docs: clarify changelog format`. small and consistent helps the aggregator.

sam: thanks all. quick timeline: final sweep 3:30pm PT tomorrow, cut at 5pm. if you can't make it, reply now and i'll reassign. otherwise i'll send a final nudge 3h before cutoff. :calendar:
